record: Naming the family and How We Look, in a browser (owner, 2026-09-17)
note: Same computer only. A student joined, rolled, gave the family its last name in the pop-up, chose each parent's looks from pictures, and reloaded. The pictures are Claude-drawn stand-ins; the figure on the map is unchanged (layered people art, docs/ART_REQUESTS.md). No LAN or district claim.
checks: before the roll nothing is asked, and the button at the bottom reads Journal
after the roll the "Family Last Name" box comes up, before the looks, and Escape does not close it
the naming card holds every one of the family by their first name (Alvin, Delia, Jasper, Levi, Marcos, Petra, Refugia, Rufino) and Continue keeps them

named, every member carries the last name (Alvin Navarro, Refugia Navarro, Marcos Navarro, Levi Navarro, Delia Navarro, Jasper Navarro, Rufino Navarro, Petra Navarro); the panel's boxes hold the first names
each parent's looks came up in turn with a picture on every choice, the defaults pressed, the preview following, and Done kept father: black hair, hat; mother: dark brown hair, pinned hair

reloaded, nothing is asked again, and the journal says who is whose without editing: "Alvin Navarro - father, 24. Married to Refugia Navarro. Father to Marcos Navarro, Levi Navarro, Delia Navarro, Jasper Navarro, Rufino Navarro and Petra Navarro."
at phone width the looks pop-up fits and the page does not scroll sideways
